product_metadata.title: Geometric Side Table
features: Slides under Couch for Drinks and Snacks
Decorate table at a Great Price!
Does Require Assembly - assembly hardware included!
description: This Geometric Side Table slides neatly up to a chair or sofa providing the perfect flat surface for your beverage, a snack, or your remote control. Function and style come together with this side table. This convenient side table slips easily underneath sofas and chairs to allow easy reaching distance for what you need. It makes a great addition to any small space, apartment, or dorm living area. Its sturdy yet fashionable burnished metal sides and wooden top provide exceptional support to this must-have-piece.
